review_type: Codex-assisted source review of actual version 3 candidates; not human approval or independent ground truth
selection_rule: Four pilot regressions plus first two non-pilot threads per project sorted by full identity; selected before 200-thread outcomes.
scope: All 12 predetermined candidates compared against actual Slack text, speaker roles, reaction users/targets, and approved glossary. No evaluation labels or external policy documents used.
limitations: Assisted judgment is fallible; this is neither human sign-off nor independent ground truth.
Twelve deliberately selected cases, including eight announcement-channel records, do not estimate full-batch accuracy.
The frozen schema has no N/A resolution value for announcements; labels alone are not treated as factual errors.
Confidence values are uncalibrated. External documents and actual incident outcomes were not retrieved.
Positive source reviews do not clear automated failures or imply human approval.
